products.name: Braintrust
products.note: Evaluation-first LLM platform; datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, prompt iteration with production trace feedback

profile_text.body:
Braintrust is a software company that describes itself as an active observability platform for AI agents, focused on helping development teams ship and maintain quality agents at scale. According to its website, the platform covers production tracing, evaluation runs, and regression detection before changes reach end users, with the stated aim of surfacing patterns automatically so teams can evaluate against expectations and iterate continuously.

The company's core product, also called Braintrust, is categorized as an AI governance and risk management platform built around an evaluation-first approach. It offers datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, and prompt iteration informed by production trace feedback. The platform includes a feature called Loop, which the site describes as generating improved prompts, scorers, and datasets automatically based on what a user wants to optimize. Braintrust also provides an MCP server that connects a coding agent to a user's AI stack, allowing logs to be queried, evaluations run, and prompts updated directly from within an IDE.
